name: Wallet
brief:
Service: Wallet. A wallet for sending and requesting money.

Data:
- Balance: amount (money)
- Transfer: id (text), to (text), amount (money)
- MoneyRequest: id (text), payer (text), amount (money)

Actions:
- balance() returns a Balance. Only reads.
- transfer(to: text, amount: money, note: optional text) returns a Transfer. Takes payment, never more than 1000 ZAR in one call, and does nothing else. Cannot be undone.
- requestMoney(payer: text, amount: money) returns a MoneyRequest. Contacts the payer on the caller's behalf and changes nothing else. Can be undone with withdrawRequest.
- withdrawRequest(request: MoneyRequest) returns nothing. Contacts the payer on the caller's behalf and changes nothing else. Cannot be undone.

Use exactly these action, parameter, type, and field names.
